items.job: Replace hub bolts and wheels under recall

items.t: 12-volt battery goes dead, car won't start or unlock
items.job: Test charging system and replace 12-volt battery
items.note: Usually free while the car is under warranty.

items.t: Defroster and heat stop working from A/C compressor fault (recall)
items.job: Update climate software and replace electric compressor if needed

items.t: Rearview camera freezes or goes blank (recall)
DC fast charging slows sharply after repeated sessions
items.note: Normally done free under warranty; labor shown is if a dealer charges for it.

items.t: Very slow fast charging in cold weather
items.job: Charging system diagnosis and software check
items.note: Slow charging in the cold is normal; pay for diagnosis only if it is slow in mild weather too.

items.t: Sudden loss of power or electrical shutdown while driving
items.job: Diagnose EV system faults and update software
items.note: Drive motor or battery repairs are covered by Toyota's EV warranty.

items.t: Uneven or fast tire wear and vibration
items.note: An alignment alone is about 1 hour of labor.

items.t: Knocking from the rear over rough roads
items.note: Parts extra if a worn link or bushing is found; should be covered under warranty on newer cars.

items.t: Wrong load capacity label with dealer accessories (recall)
items.job: Corrected load label mailed to owner
